_readme: Display order of the EPK gallery, top to bottom. The page places each photo in the shortest column, so this order is also the lightbox order.
master is the filename in _source/gallery. The part before the double underscore names who shot it, credits live in photo-credits.json.

It was arranged so black and white frames never stack, similar shots and colours are kept apart, drum shots and the two logo tiles are spaced out, and the darkest frames sit next to brighter ones, at both the 3 column desktop and 2 column phone layouts.
To add a photo, drop the master in _source/gallery and add an entry here where it should sit, then run scripts/optimize_images.py. A master missing from this list is appended at the end with a note.
